title: Supplementary material: Risk Map of Dengue Transmission in the Metropolitan Area of Mexico City
description: Extended methods and supplementary results (Aedes aegypti ovitrap model, imported dengue cases model, and integrated risk map) for the manuscript Risk Map of Dengue Transmission in the Metropolitan Area of Mexico City. The document is a rendered Quarto file (HTML) with its source (.qmd). Confirmed dengue case data are not distributed.
